loyal,> 2,-,0.05,'loyal'

expect.csv:

Aggregate,SUM
logic,boolean

vectors.description: The DMN letter U is unique
The DMN letter A is any
The DMN letter F is first
The DMN letter R is rule_order
The DMN letter C is collect
The DMN letter C+ is collect with sum
The DMN letter C< is collect with min
The DMN letter C> is collect with max
The DMN letter c# is collect with count
A row may have fewer fields than the header, and empty fields end the header and rows
Every form of input cell, with its node and its canonical text
Inputs and outputs are expressions; strings print between single quotes, or double quotes with escapes

expect.csv:
HIT POLICY,first
order.total * 1.21,`first name`,THEN tax,THEN note,THEN 'two words'
>= 100,'Ana',order.total * 0.21,"""a\tb""",'x'

vectors.description: Rows without a name are row_<n>; an empty output cell leaves the key out; descriptions pass to rules
Under priority, output values rank rows: k - r, equal ranks equal priorities

given.table_csv:
HIT POLICY,P
RULE,score,"THEN risk IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')"
a,< 300,'high'
b,< 600,'medium'
c,-,'low'
d,> 900,'high'

expect.csv:
HIT POLICY,priority
RULE,score,"THEN risk IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')"
a,< 300,'high'
b,< 600,'medium'
c,-,'low'
d,> 900,'high'

vectors.description: The first output with values decides, the next breaks ties; outputs without values are skipped

given.table_csv:
HIT POLICY,priority
x,THEN note,"THEN level IN (1, 2)","THEN tier IN ('gold', 'silver')"
> 1,'a',2,'gold'
> 2,'b',1,'silver'
> 3,'c',1,'gold'

vectors.description: A quoted field that is not closed is a format_error where it starts
Text after a closing quote is a format_error
A row with more fields than the header is a format_error at the first extra field
Settings without a header line are a format_error
RULE, PRIORITY and DESCRIPTION are columns at most once
An empty header field before others is a format_error
A setting given twice is a format_error
A setting with a field after its value is a format_error
An unknown policy is a format_error at its field
AGGREGATE after a DMN letter that gives one is a format_error
A priority that is not an int is a format_error at its field
A syntax error in an unquoted cell is located within it
A cell leaves out its column: x > 5 in a cell is a syntax error after x
An error in a quoted cell is located at the field
A cell breaking a construction rule is an expression_error at the cell
An input that is a condition is an expression_error at its header
An output cell that is a condition is a rule_definition_error at the cell
An output header is THEN, a key and optional values; an error in a quoted header is at its field
A cell of an output with values must hold one of them
A cell of an output with values cannot be empty
Output values are distinct
Output keys are distinct
Under priority, a row priority next to output values is a rule_definition_error at the priority
Rule names are unique: an unnamed row may clash with a name
An aggregate needs collect: the error is at the AGGREGATE line
In JSON, an error in a cell's text points to the cell
In JSON, a row with the wrong number of cells is a format_error
A table has at least one input
An unknown key in a row is a format_error
An input cell is a string: any value is written -
In JSON the policy is a lowercase name, never a DMN letter
In JSON, an output cell outside its values points to the cell
A decision table has no form in the text syntax
JSON shape: inputs not array
JSON shape: input not string
JSON shape: hit policy not string
JSON shape: unknown aggregate
JSON shape: logic not string
JSON shape: unknown logic
JSON shape: strict not boolean
JSON shape: outputs not array
JSON shape: output not object
JSON shape: output name not string
JSON shape: output name missing
JSON shape: output values not array
JSON shape: output value null
JSON shape: unknown output key
JSON shape: rows not array
JSON shape: row not object
JSON shape: row name not string
JSON shape: row priority not int
JSON shape: row outputs missing
JSON shape: output cell not string
JSON shape: too many cells
JSON shape: unknown table key
JSON shape: multi line cell error
JSON shape: input header error
JSON shape: output cell error
The separator is the first comma, semicolon or tab outside quotes and parentheses

vectors.description: A CSV text has the size limit of texts
Every input cell holds a copy of its column: a long expression in many rows reaches the limit
An input that is a condition is reported before an error in a cell
The shape is checked before the logic is looked up
The number of cells is part of the shape, checked before the text of any cell
Repeated output values are reported before an error in a cell
In CSV, the inputs and outputs are checked before any row is read
AGGREGATE before a DMN letter that gives one is also a format_error
The separator is found on the first line that has one
